confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Queenstown tourism pricing. I did not check live booking pages or current menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation anchors are least certain because July is peak ski season and prices can run well above these figures. The FX value comes from search results that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the RBA page itself, so verify it against the official table before using it for accounting.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on NZ resort and tourist-heavy regional towns with similar winter demand, with restaurant and drink prices scaled to typical New Zealand hospitality levels. No single named comparable city was used.
